messages.author: abebf473fc87d491
messages.subject: problem positioning legends
parts:
Hi all,

running Windows XP professional 2002 - service pack 2, R 2.9.2,
ggplot2 0.8.3
I tried the following little program

require(ggplot2)
dat <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = rnorm(5))
qplot(x,y, data = dat, colour = x) + opts(legend.position = 'bottom')

and get as error message

> qplot(x,y, data = dat, colour = x) + opts(legend.position = 'bottom')
Error in grid.Call.graphics("L_setviewport", pvp, TRUE) :
Non-finite location and/or size for viewport

In fact, any other position than 'right' or 'none' fails too.

Do I handle the legend.position property incorrectly?

Kind regards
Reinhold
